name: Coastal Conservancy grants
summary: California state grants, awarded through a rolling pre-application, for projects that restore and protect the coast and coastal watersheds, expand public access and build climate resilience. Nonprofits and public agencies can apply.

geography.label: California coast, San Francisco Bay and coastal watersheds

status.quote: Most Conservancy grants are awarded through a rolling pre-application solicitation.

applicant_types.quote: Public Agencies, including Joint Power Authorities and Federally-Recognized Indian Tribes Nonprofit organizations with 501(c)(3) status Other community-based organizations and non-federally-recognized tribes may apply with a 501(c)(3) fiscal sponsor

geography.quote: The Coastal Conservancy funds a wide variety of projects along the California coast, San Francisco Bay, and in coastal watersheds

access.quote: The first step in the application process is to submit a pre-application.

window.quote: Most Conservancy grants are awarded through a rolling pre-application solicitation.

amount.quote: it is anticipated that most grants will be between $200,000 and $5,000,000.
